title: Companion fullscreen Before/After comparison
description: Opens a real run with paired evidence, proves inline and fullscreen Before-to-After swiping, then verifies the family pair navigator.

run_id.description: Run whose evidence package exposes a visual pair and whose family exposes at least two visual pairs.

family_id.description: Family containing the run and at least two visual pairs.

proofTargets.claim: A Companion evidence pair opens as a labeled fullscreen comparison and swipes from Before to After.
The run evidence card swipes between Before and After.
The family evidence surface selects one pair at a time and advances through its explicit pair controls.

wait-review.intent: Start from the live review queue.

open-history.intent: Load completed runs so the stable evidence fixture can be selected from the real queue.

wait-history.intent: Confirm the queue switched from active runs to run history.

open-run.intent: Open a run with real paired evidence.

wait-run.intent: Keep the selected run's evidence available for comparison.

open-evidence.intent: Select the run's visual evidence workspace.

wait-evidence.intent: Keep the primary visual delta available for inspection.

swipe-inline-after.intent: Prove the shared card itself changes from Before to After.

confirm-inline-after.intent: Confirm the inline swipe selected After.

select-inline-before.intent: Return the shared card to Before before opening the full comparison.

open-comparison.intent: Expand the shared comparison from its Before preview.

wait-fullscreen.intent: Confirm the dedicated fullscreen comparison is visible.

capture-before.label: Fullscreen Before state
capture-before.intent: Preserve the labeled baseline at a size where its visual details can be judged.

swipe-after.intent: Swipe the fullscreen comparison to its After state.

confirm-after-selected.intent: Prove the swipe selected the After state before accepting its screenshot as evidence.

capture-after.label: Fullscreen After state
capture-after.intent: Preserve the changed state at the same reviewable scale after the native gesture.

close-comparison.intent: Return to the run evidence workspace after completing the full-size comparison.

wait-comparison-dismissed.intent: Confirm the comparison closed without leaving a stale modal over the run.

return-review.intent: Return through the app navigation before opening the related family.

wait-review-returned.intent: Confirm the live review queue is visible again.

open-family-history.intent: Return to completed families before selecting the fixture's family workspace.

wait-family-history.intent: Confirm completed families are visible again.

open-family.intent: Open the same run family from the live queue to verify its shared comparison controls.

wait-family-pairs.intent: Confirm the first family pair is selected without a nested horizontal rail.

next-family-pair.intent: Advance the family evidence surface using its explicit pair control.

confirm-family-next-pair.intent: Confirm the family evidence surface selected the second pair.
